label: First lying diastolic blood pressure (mmHg) - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: First lying diastolic blood pressure (mmHg) - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 blood pressure and pulse rate measures. Measurements were performed twice (one minute apart) recumbent in the left arm after 3 minutes of rest, and then twice (one minute apart) following 3 minutes of standing quietly. Also measured in phase 2 - library file I46P2_BP.
